text_block_list.text: One day, в тренировке camp...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And that should do it for today's
schedule.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Heh, did I rush through it a bit too
quickly?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: Do you want to do some extra training?

text_block_list.text:
No, thanks. It's a bit early, but let's call
it a day.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Actually, I promised to meet the
younger
students for a party tonight.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Summer camp training is pretty
hardcore, so it
helps if we all support
each other!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I'm in charge of the shopping because I
have a
car, so it's time to get going!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
What do you mean? You're coming with
me!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
What do you mean? You're coming with
me!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Let's take a drive and watch the
beautiful sunset!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: VRRROOOOOOM!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Blasting away at top speed while
surrounded by
nature is just the best!
And the sunset is gorgeous!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Марузенски and I finish up shopping and
return to
the car. Just as we're about to
head back...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: This can't be! Why aren't you moving?! What's wrong, Tata?!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Марузенски's car suddenly breaks down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Tata is having a hard time
driving on
these unfamiliar, rough
roads...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
What should I do? I'm worried about her,
but
everyone is expecting me at the
party...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: You should go see your junior classmates.
Let's see if we can fix your car somehow.

text_block_list.text:
What? You want me to go ahead and
leave you
here, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
What? You want me to go ahead and
leave you
here, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I guess I could deliver everything in time
if I run
fast enough, but...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: Think of it as today's extra training!

text_block_list.text:
...Geez, how am I supposed to refuse
when you
put it that way? No fair,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
But okay, I'll hurry and deliver what we
bought!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I'll be back as soon as I deliver it, so
take care of
Tata until then!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: What a perfect little workout! Off I go!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
And just like that, Марузенски takes off
at top
speed with the goods in hand.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even if we did try to fix her, I wouldn't
know
where to start...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I've got it! Maybe banging on her
a little
will do the trick!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
That's what you do when your TV's
picture is all
fuzzy, right? You give it a
karate chop at a
forty-five degree angle!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: I mean, I don't do that, but...

text_block_list.text:
Seriously?! Isn't that what everybody
does?!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: A-anyway, um, let's give it a try!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Come on, Tata, wake up! This is no time
for a
nap!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Марузенски bangs on the steering
wheel, and...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Vroom... VROOOOOM!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: It worked! Tata's awake!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Heehee. Sometimes it just takes a good
thumping!
Come on, let's head back!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
And so, with the car finally moving
again, we're
able to get safely back to
camp.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The car is later fixed without incident,
and the
party ends up a huge success.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But when Марузенски extols the virtues
of hitting
stuff to fix it, everyone at the
party insists that
she's just going to
break things.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
